name: Explorer: Robust Collection of Interactable GUI Elements
notes: The annotation and scope were reviewed against the primary paper abstract. Experimental results and released artifacts have not been independently reproduced.
summary: Explorer collects interactable GUI elements from a live target application and records user sessions for application-specific model training. It links repeated interface states into a navigation map that supports path planning and voice-directed interaction.

name: GUIrilla: A Scalable Framework for Automated Desktop UI Exploration
notes: The annotation and scope were reviewed against the primary paper abstract. Experimental results and released artifacts have not been independently reproduced.
summary: GUIrilla systematically explores macOS interfaces to collect interaction traces and accessibility metadata for downstream GUI research. It organizes these observations into hierarchical MacApp Trees and describes an accessibility-driven collection library.

name: Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution
notes: Reviewed against the complete retained official abstract. Experimental findings and release availability have not been independently reproduced or verified.
summary: Syll combines tool calls, shell execution and visual GUI control in a personal-automation runtime. It turns user demonstrations into reusable skills and exposes execution logs, keyframes and approval checkpoints for inspection.

name: OmegaUse-SOP: SOP Engineering for Professional Computer Use from Human Demonstrations

summary: OmegaUse-SOP converts expert GUI demonstrations into configurable procedures and refines them with domain rules and human input. It records, abstracts, grounds and verifies live execution, with a case study of photovoltaic simulation workflows in PVsyst 7.2.
